title: This Beetle Steers by the Milky Way (First Animal Ever Found)

scenes.text: This beetle steers by the Milky Way.
African dung beetles roll their dung ball away in a perfectly straight line, even at night.
Going straight stops them circling back to the pile, where rivals steal the ball.
In 2013, researchers put tiny cardboard hats on the beetles, blocking the sky. They wandered.
In a planetarium, the Milky Way alone was enough to keep them straight.
It was the first proof that any animal navigates by our galaxy.

description:
African dung beetles use the glow of the Milky Way to roll their dung balls in straight lines at night.
Researchers at Lund University showed it in 2013, using cardboard hats and a planetarium.
What other animal do you think uses the stars? Comment below.
first_comment: Scientists put cardboard hats on dung beetles to prove it. Which animal experiment would you most like to see?
